layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Protocol - tight gaps for dashboards, wide asymmetrical for marketing
layout_and_spacing.desktop_only_enforcement: Use min-w-[1024px] or standard responsive utilities ensuring desktop layout dominance. Hide mobile hamburger logic.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4f6ef7] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-[#3d59d4] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,110,247,0.4)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:border-white/30 hover:bg-white/5 transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#4f6ef7] to-[#00c4cc] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300

cards.base: bg-[#111118] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300
cards.glass: bg-[#111118]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,110,247,0.15)] transition-all duration-300
cards.surface: bg-[#1a1a2a] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-inner border border-white/5

animations.page_transition: framer-motion initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}} animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}} exit={{opacity: 0, y: -20}}

image_urls.description: Abstract floating 3D glass books with neon electric blue and teal glowing data streams
Spark.E Mascot - cute friendly glowing robotic tutor with blue/teal accents
Futuristic glowing notebook for Notes AI feature visualization
3D gamepad with graduation cap for Gamified Arcade visualization
Moody neon lighting student aesthetic background

specific_page_instructions.landing: Hero section must use the abstract 3D books graphic (hero_graphic). Apply a backdrop-blur-xl over the #0a0a0f background to give a deep spatial feel. Include testimonials in bento grid style with #111118 cards and #4f6ef7 glows on hover. The stats bar should use #f5a623 for numbers.
specific_page_instructions.dashboard: Use a persistent left sidebar. Main content area should use the dashboard bento grid. Drag-drop upload area must feature dashed borders with a subtle teal #00c4cc glow on hover. Recent study sets as glassmorphism cards.
specific_page_instructions.study_set: Render 5 tool cards with distinct icons (Notes, Flashcards, Quiz, Chat, Arcade). Use high contrast typography and subtle scale hover effects.
specific_page_instructions.notes_ai: Use Notes AI graphic. Provide depth toggles (Simple, Detailed, Expert) using Shadcn segmented controls customized to the dark theme.
specific_page_instructions.flashcards: MUST implement framer-motion 3D flip (rotateY). Use #1a1a2a for the card surface. Add a subtle border glow when flipping.
specific_page_instructions.arcade: The most gamified area. Use the arcade_mode_graphic in the header. Render 3 mini-game cards. Heavy use of the electric blue and gold highlights.
specific_page_instructions.spark_e_chat: Chatbot interface using the mascot graphic as the avatar. 3 tabs required. Use Shadcn Tabs component but customize to remove default Vercel look (e.g., use an underlined animated indicator or pill-shape with #4f6ef7 background).

testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='flashcard-flip-btn', data-testid='arcade-mode-card').
